sources.title: audarai/Audar-TTS-V1-Flash · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Audar-TTS-V1-Flash is the smallest, fastest member of the Audar-TTS family — a compact 553M-parameter open-weights speech model that turns text into natural, expressive speech and clones any voice from a 5-15 second reference clip, with no per-speaker fine-tuning.

sources.title: GitHub - AudarAI/Audar-ASR-V1: Arabic-first generative speech ...
sources.snippet: Audar-ASR-V1 is a family of Arabic-first, generative speech-recognition models from AudarAI. It recasts transcription as audio-conditioned next-token prediction over a unified text vocabulary — a language-model decoder rather than a CTC or transducer objective.

sources.title: Audar-ASR-V1: A Speech-to-Text Model for Indian Languages - Onegen
sources.snippet: Audar-ASR-V1 is a free, open-source speech-to-text model outperforming Whisper for Indian languages, offering developers high accuracy via a simple Python API.
